name: After-hours Answering
best_for: Any business with a forwarded line

handoff_rules.condition: The caller describes an emergency as defined in the brief

brief_prefill.goal: Handle calls when the business is closed, collect messages, and escalate genuine emergencies.
brief_prefill.never_do: Never give safety or medical advice. Never guess whether something is an emergency — use the rules given.

steps: Greet the caller, say the business is closed and when it reopens
Ask whether the matter is urgent
If it is an emergency per the rules, follow the emergency instruction
Otherwise take a message: name, callback number, what they need

analysis_fields.name: is_emergency
analysis_fields.description: True when the call met the emergency rules.

analysis_fields.name: callback_number
analysis_fields.description: The number to call back on.

analysis_fields.name: message
analysis_fields.description: The message left for the team.

rules: Use the emergency definitions from the brief; never invent your own.
Never give safety or medical advice.

example_texts.plumbing: We are a residential plumbing company covering the West Island. Drain cleaning, burst pipes, water heaters and bathroom renovations. We run a 24-hour emergency line.
example_texts.dental: We are a family dental clinic in Laval. We do check-ups, cleanings, fillings, crowns and emergency toothache appointments. Two dentists, one hygienist, open six days a week.
example_texts.auto: We are an independent garage doing maintenance, brakes, tyres and pre-purchase inspections on most makes. Courtesy car by arrangement.
example_texts.legal: We are a two-lawyer family law practice downtown. Divorce, custody and mediation. First consultation is thirty minutes and is paid.
example_texts.generic: Describe what your business does, who you serve, and what makes a call worth taking.
